copy.headline: Your first Sunday can be at 12 noon in Southfield
copy.subhead: Come to 24301 Telegraph or join the Hour of Power online at 8:15 am
copy.hook: Ever wondered what a real Kingdom gathering feels like?
copy.body: Pastor Curtis and Pastor Tammy lead a clear, Scripture‑centered service every First Saturday at 12 pm. Walk through the doors, find a seat, and experience the same authority you read about. If you prefer home, the online Hour of Power starts weekdays at 8:15 am. Choose the way that fits, and plan your visit today.
